model.name: SVG renders in fullscreen iframe natively
model.description: SVG diagrams at /md/<path>.svg render inside an iframe covering most of the viewport. Pan/zoom uses the browser native/default page zoom inside the iframe — no custom JS. The iframe isolation scopes zoom to the SVG, keeping the outer page static.
model.tronQuote:
> TRON: "we need to optimize the svg view. the structure is right but i want a iframe that basically covers most of the screen and if i pan zoom, the svg in the iframe gets panned zoomed not the whole page."
> TRON (clarification): "it just should show the svg in the iframe and fall back to standard panning and zooming of it as the default page functionality."
